notes: Integrity record for the model binaries. sha256 and byte size are verified at load time when the file exists; a mismatch is a warning, and DRAW_MODEL_STRICT=1 turns it into an error. The binaries do not live in git: the official distribution is this repository's 'models-2026-11-02' Release, and 'python tools/fetch_models.py' downloads the files listed here into models/, verifying sha256 and size against this record. Without the fetch, a fresh clone runs on the fallbacks (classic sheet detector and legacy ink stack). hand_landmarker.task is a Google MediaPipe model (Apache-2.0), redistributed unmodified from the official source given in its entry.
